requirements:
This model represents robots in charge of performing tasks.
There are robots that have an id. Robots can be of type cleaning robot and transport robot. Robots can
perform tasks, which have an id. When a robot performs a task, the task execution is recorded. A
task execution has an id, a start time and a location. The location can be either corridors or rooms.

classes.name: CleaningRobot
classes.description: A specific type of robot that performs cleaning tasks.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents the location where a task execution occurs (corridors or rooms).

classes.name: Robot
classes.description: Represents robots that have an ID and can perform tasks.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task with an ID and can be performed by robots.

classes.name: TaskExecution
